top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Rise on AI Enthusiasm, Bonds Slide: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rose as better-than-expected earnings from CoreWeave Inc. helped sustain interest in the artificial intelligence trade, offsetting a Wall Street selloff fueled by hotter-than-expected US inflation data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: China Copper Crunch Puts Industry on Defensive as Costs Soar
top_signals.summary: China’s copper crunch is squeezing activity and margins at the firms that shape the metal into wires, rods and tubes for use in products from cables to electronics and consumer goods.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
